Nafees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 21
July, 2023

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:48075
Court No. - 11
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3441 of 2022
Applicant :- Nafees

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Qazi Sabihur Rahman,Ali Hasan,Mohd. Suhail,Rajesh P. Singh Bagh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

Despite notice,
none has appeared for the complainant.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report.

Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., as well as the statement during trial, which in on record, the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her own freewill.
The age of the victim as per the medical report is not clear.

There is no determination of age of the victim at Nafees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8803915/
1 this stage, which is subject matter of trial.

entities.text: Nafees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

4. Considering the submissions on record and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 30.03.2019 and there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in near future, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Nafees be released on bail in FIR No.175 of 2019, under Section 363, 366-A, 376 IPC, Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act & Section 3(2)(V) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, P.S. Mohanlalganj, District Lucknow on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 nishant  Nafees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8803915/
